This model is a fine-tuned version of [openai/whisper-small](https://huggingface.co/openai/whisper-small) on the mozilla-foundation/common_voice_11_0 fa dataset. We also did data augmentation using audiomentations library along with hyperparameter tuning to acquire the best parameters.
It achieves the following results on the evaluation set:
- Loss: 0.1813
